fields.name: claims
fields.description: Total Medicare Part D prescription claims filled in year t

fields.name: beneficiaries
fields.description: Total unique Medicare Part D beneficiaries in year t

fields.name: spending
fields.description: Total gross drug spending ($) in year t

fields.name: avg_spending_per_claim
fields.description: Average gross spending per claim ($) in year t

fields.name: avg_spending_per_beneficiary
fields.description: Average gross spending per beneficiary ($) in year t

fields.name: manufacturer_count
fields.description: Number of active manufacturers producing/labeling drug in year t

fields.name: claims_lag_1
fields.description: Prescription claims filled in year t-1

fields.name: claims_growth_yoy
fields.description: Year-over-year claims percentage growth ((t - t-1) / t-1)

fields.name: beneficiaries_lag_1
fields.description: Unique beneficiaries in year t-1

fields.name: beneficiary_growth_yoy
fields.description: Year-over-year beneficiary percentage growth

fields.name: spending_lag_1
fields.description: Gross drug spending ($) in year t-1

fields.name: spending_growth_yoy
fields.description: Year-over-year gross spending percentage growth

fields.name: avg_spending_per_claim_growth
fields.description: Year-over-year unit cost growth rate

fields.name: years_observed_before_t
fields.description: Count of historical CMS observation years prior to t

fields.name: claims_rolling_mean_2y
fields.description: 2-year rolling average claim volume [t-1, t]

fields.name: claims_rolling_std_2y
fields.description: 2-year rolling standard deviation of claims

fields.name: spending_rolling_mean_2y
fields.description: 2-year rolling average spending ($)

fields.name: is_first_observation_year
fields.description: Flag indicating baseline observation year with no prior lag

fields.name: prior_shortage_count
fields.description: Cumulative count of FDA shortage events first posted in years <= t

fields.name: ever_shortage_before_t
fields.description: Flag indicating if drug experienced any FDA shortage in years <= t

fields.name: years_since_last_shortage
fields.description: Years elapsed since most recent FDA shortage (or -1 if none)

fields.name: is_single_manufacturer
fields.description: Flag indicating sole manufacturer reliance (manufacturer_count == 1)

fields.name: therapeutic_category
fields.description: Primary FDA therapeutic category classification

usage_notes: Input records must match this feature schema exactly before passing to model inference.
